canonical_question: What specific 'outstanding physical and chemical properties' distinguish HEAs from traditional materials in this context?

question_variants.question: What specific 'outstanding physical and chemical properties' distinguish HEAs from traditional materials in this context?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text states the material has 'outstanding physical and chemical properties' but does not enumerate or specify what those properties are in contrast to traditional materials.

answers.answer: The document mentions that SLM-built HEA has 'outstanding physical and chemical properties' but does not list or define specific properties that distinguish it from traditional materials.
answers.conditions: All temperature ranges (25 °C to 700 °C or higher)
answers.measurement_outcome: Outstanding mechanical properties compared to reported HEAs.
answers.boundary_limitation: No specific physical or chemical properties are enumerated.
evidence_spans: SLM-built HEA had a face-centered cubic (FCC) single-phase random solid solution.
In addition, SLM-built HEA was composed of epitaxial growth grains, dislocation network and nano-sized oxides.

Room- and high-temperature compression tests confirmed that SLM-built HEA has outstanding mechanical properties in all temperature ranges compared to equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi HEAs reported up to the present.

source_evidence_spans: It also has outstanding physical and chemical properties
